## Section B — Gherkin Feature File Structure

**Folder layout used for this epic** (one `.feature` file per epic — all 5 stories live in one file,
grouped by story with comment section dividers, each scenario carrying both `@aa-1` (feature-level) and
`@{story-id}` tags for filtering; step definitions remain split per story for file-size sanity):
```
features/aa-1/
  aa-1.feature        ← ALL 5 stories' scenarios, one Feature block, sectioned by story
tests/step-definitions/aa-1/
  aa-10.steps.ts   [Stage 7]
  aa-11.steps.ts   [Stage 7]
  aa-12.steps.ts   [Stage 7]
  aa-13.steps.ts   [Stage 7]
  aa-14.steps.ts   [Stage 7]
```

**[features/aa-1/aa-1.feature](../../features/aa-1/aa-1.feature) has been written** — one file, 25
scenarios across the 5 stories (`AA-1-TC-01-04`, `AA-1-TC-01-06`, and `AA-1-TC-03-04` use
`Scenario Outline` + `Examples:` per Rule 6, since they're data-driven negative/boundary cases):

| Section | Story | Scenarios |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | AA-10 — Register | 7 |
| 2 | AA-11 — Login (valid) | 5 |
| 3 | AA-12 — Login (invalid) | 5 |
| 4 | AA-13 — Logout | 4 (TC-04-04 excluded — AUTOMATE LATER) |
| 5 | AA-14 — Update profile | 4 (TC-05-03 excluded — AUTOMATE LATER) |

Only ONE `Background:` exists in the file (`Given the test environment is configured` — env-configurable
base URL, see `support/config.ts`; updated post-approval, see `test_cases_AA-1.md` Drift log) since
Background applies to
every scenario in a Feature regardless of section — story-specific preconditions (e.g. "the user is not
logged in", "a registered account exists") are inlined into each scenario's own `Given` steps instead of
relying on a per-story Background block.

Literal values used in these files (personas, boundary passwords, expected error strings) are the
values Stage 6 will externalize into `test-data/register.yaml`, `test-data/login.yaml`, and
`test-data/profile.yaml` per the Stage 6 Test Data Strategy — do not treat them as one-off examples
to be re-invented later; they are the source of truth.

**Step definition mapping (representative — full table produced in Stage 6):**

| Gherkin Step | Step Definition Method | ToolshopUi/ToolshopApi Method Called |
|---|---|---|
| "the user fills in the registration form with:" (data table) | `whenFillsRegistrationForm` | `toolshopUi.fillRegistrationForm(fields)` |
| "the user logs in with the registered email and password" | `whenLogsInWithRegisteredCredentials` | `toolshopUi.login(email, password)` |
| "the user opens the account dropdown" / "clicks {string}" | `whenOpensAccountDropdown` / `whenClicksNav` | `toolshopUi.openAccountMenu()` / `toolshopUi.clickNavItem(label)` |
| `"POST /users/register" returns status {int}` | `thenApiReturnsStatus` | `toolshopApi` response interception (see Stage 6 §7 cross-layer pattern) |
| "the page displays {string}" | `thenPageDisplays` | `toolshopUi.getBannerText()` |

## Section F — Execution Order & Dependencies

```
 1. AA-1-TC-01-01 — Successful registration [no dependency]
 2. AA-1-TC-01-02 — Registration API confirm [no dependency — independent registration]
 3. AA-1-TC-01-03 — Duplicate email rejected → depends on: an existing account (self-seeds or chains after #1)
 4. AA-1-TC-01-04 — Required field blank (Outline) [parallel — no dependency]
 5. AA-1-TC-01-05 — Malformed email rejected [parallel — no dependency]
 6. AA-1-TC-01-06 — Password rules (Outline) [parallel — no dependency]
 7. AA-1-TC-01-07 — Breached password rejected [parallel — no dependency]
 8. AA-1-TC-02-01 — Valid login redirect → depends on: a registered account (API-seeded)
 9. AA-1-TC-02-02 — Login API confirm → depends on: a registered account (API-seeded)
10. AA-1-TC-02-03 — Header reflects login → depends on: #8/#9 pattern (fresh login per scenario)
11. AA-1-TC-02-04 — Session persists reload → depends on: a logged-in session
12. AA-1-TC-02-05 — Empty login fields blocked [parallel — no dependency]
13. AA-1-TC-03-01 — Wrong password error → depends on: an existing registered email
14. AA-1-TC-03-02 — Non-existent email error [parallel — no dependency, unregistered email]
15. AA-1-TC-03-03 — No session on failed login → depends on: #13 or #14 pattern
16. AA-1-TC-03-04 — Empty login field (Outline) [parallel — no dependency]
17. AA-1-TC-03-05 — Malformed login email [parallel — no dependency]
18. AA-1-TC-04-01 — Logout clears session → depends on: a logged-in session
19. AA-1-TC-04-02 — Logout API confirm → depends on: a fresh login+logout cycle
20. AA-1-TC-04-03 — Unauthenticated /account → depends on: a logged-out session
21. AA-1-TC-04-05 — /users/refresh 500 → depends on: a fresh login+logout cycle
22. AA-1-TC-05-01 — Profile pre-filled → depends on: a logged-in session with a known persona
23. AA-1-TC-05-02 — Profile update saved → depends on: #22 pattern (on profile page)
24. AA-1-TC-05-04 — Blank field profile update → depends on: a logged-in session on profile page
25. AA-1-TC-05-05 — Unauthenticated /account/profile → depends on: a logged-out session
```

Note: because AA-1 has no seed/admin API for user creation (registration is itself the data-seeding
mechanism, per `test_plan_AA-1.md` §"Epic-specific data setup"), "API-seeded" above still routes
through `POST /users/register` — it is API-level, not UI-level, seeding, not a truly independent
external fixture.
